target_customer: RevOps, BizOps, sales and marketing teams that run AI agents on go-to-market data
problem: GTM teams cannot trust AI agents because the data is incomplete, inconsistent or stale, and keeping agent context and skills up to date is manual.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform for building GTM agents on a synced data layer (pricing not public)
product_category: GTM data layer and agent platform

founders.name: Melanie Chen
previous_startups: Founding engineer at two seed-stage startups (names not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page: head of post sales at Chalk AI (8th employee), founding engineer at two seed-stage startups, data infrastructure engineer at Plaid.

founders.name: Bill Qin
founders.background_notes: YC page: led development of Chalk SQL, a federated query engine; three time USAMO participant. The launch post says the team has worked at Plaid, Jane Street and Chalk.

competitors.name: Reevo
competitors.what: AI-native GTM platform spanning marketing, sales and customer success

technical_complexity.rationale: Syncing CRM, calls and email into a queryable store with citations and replayable snapshots is standard data engineering with hard parts in freshness and agent reliability; the founders come from a feature store and query engine company.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and accumulated GTM context create some lock in, but several funded platforms offer a GTM data layer and agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known; CRMs and funded GTM agent startups already offered overlapping features.

market_need_then: The CEO says she spent about 20 hours a week reviewing agent work and that conversations with more than 100 companies shaped the product (per a launch article dated October 2026); GTM agent startups raised sizable rounds in 2025 and 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses withkiwi.ai (prefix and .ai); kiwi.com belongs to others.

identity.logo: A kiwi logo (site mention; design not described)
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and confident, tagline 'your GTM agent's favorite data engineer'

branding.brand_signature: The line 'your GTM agent's favorite data engineer'

brand_strength.rationale: Kiwi is a common word shared by many companies, so the name is easy to say but hard to own in search; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Kiwi is a Fall 2026 company with two founders from Chalk AI, Plaid and Jane Street backgrounds who launched in October 2026. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff news exists. It enters a crowded GTM agent market where Reevo, Default, Alta and HockeyStack have all raised large rounds, so differentiation rests on its cited and replayable data layer.
notes: Funding: Dealroom lists a $125k seed with hidden investors, a single aggregator, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitor funding dates for Default, Alta and HockeyStack were not confirmed, so source_date is null and they may not all predate the batch. Several unrelated companies share the Kiwi name and were excluded. Default (Series A, $20M total), Alta ($25M Series A) and HockeyStack ($50M Series A) also sell GTM agents, but their announcement dates were not confirmed, so they are left out of the dated list. Completeness pass: the 125K seed (no date or investors) rests on a single database (Dealroom, partly AI generated text). Larger Kiwi rounds in other databases belong to different companies.
